title: The Demon Core's screwdriver
caption:
The only thing between a room full of physicists and a runaway chain reaction was a screwdriver held by hand. 🪛
A neutron reflector bounces escaping neutrons back into the core, so closing the shell can push it past critical in an instant.
What's the sketchiest 'safety system' you've ever seen at work?
sources: Los Alamos National Laboratory history: Louis Slotin criticality accident, 21 May 1946 (beryllium reflector halves held apart with a screwdriver; Slotin died nine days later)
Wikipedia, Demon core ("tickling the dragon's tail")
